subject: Aurelia MAP: implementation milestones & owners
messages:
From: Emily Reid <emily.reid@aurelia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed milestone window

Hi Olga / Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a starting point MAP (Aurelia_MAP_Draft.xlsx) with the milestones we discussed on the call. High level asks:

- We need a go-live readiness window in mid-July to support our Q3 product launch.
- Primary concerns from our side: data retention settings, org-level logging, and SSO setup timeline.

Could you please confirm who on your side would own each milestone and whether the mid-July target looks feasible?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@aurelia.com) for SOW and billing cadence items — they may have timing constraints.

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet; 3 tabs), Aurelia_SOW_notes.docx (referenced)

Best,
Emily Reid
Senior Program Manager — Aurelia Systems
emily.reid@aurelia.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emily Reid <emily.reid@aurelia.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed milestone window

Emily — thanks for the draft and the clear priorities. We reviewed the spreadsheet and sketched an initial cross-functional plan below. I added Naomi (Customer Success lead) and Marcus (Eng) to confirm technical constraints and owner commitments.

Quick summary (proposed):
- Kickoff & discovery (Aurelia + Redwood): target 2026-03-22 — Owner: Olga Petrov (Redwood) / Emily Reid (Aurelia)
- SSO and IDP testing: target 2026-04-19 — Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood Eng) / Aurelia Engineering
- Data retention & audit log config: target 2026-05-03 — Owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood Eng) / Aurelia SecOps
- Integration dry-run (sandbox): target 2026-06-14 — Owner: Naomi Feldman (Redwood CS) / Aurelia Integration Lead
- Production cutover / go-live (soft): target 2026-07-15 — Owner: Naomi Feldman / Emily Reid

Notes / risks we flagged:
- SSO timeline is dependent on Aurelia IDP access and test accounts; an early provisioning step will help keep April date.
- Data export shape (for SonicData ingestion) needs final confirmation — Matt Jenkins from SonicData is CC'd on this thread.

Action items for next week:
1) Emily to confirm IDP admin who can share test credentials by 2026-03-12.
2) Marcus to review data export sample and call out any non-standard transforms by 2026-03-10.
3) Naomi to schedule a 60-minute kickoff with stakeholders for week of 2026-03-22.

I'll attach a cleaned MAP after we get your confirmations.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Emily Reid <emily.reid@aurelia.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed milestone window

Hi all — quick engineering note on the tentative dates and the data shape item:

- SSO: April 19 is achievable if we get test SP metadata and an admin account by 2026-03-12. Without that, the SSO window slides by ~2–3 weeks.
- Data export: I reviewed the sample Matt sent. Two items to resolve before we can commit: 1) tokenization / pre-token length (we'll need a max sequence guide), 2) timestamps in UTC vs local (affects KV cache alignment).

Proposed tweak to milestones for buffer: move Integration dry-run to 2026-06-21 (one week later) and keep go-live soft to 2026-07-22 as contingency. If Aurelia can provide an earlier data sample and the IDP credentials on time, we can compress back to your original targets.

Dev contact for hands-on work: Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.com). He will own SSO integration and the export transform scripts.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Software Engineer — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Reid <emily.reid@aurelia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aurelia.com>, Matt Jenkins <matt.jenkins@sonicdata.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed milestone window

Thanks Olga / Marcus — that all looks sensible. Procurement requested we attach a redlined SOW and confirm billing cadence; procurement@aurelia.com will send a separate doc this week.

Confirming the next steps from Aurelia:
- IDP admin will share SP metadata and test account by 2026-03-12 — Owner: Aurelia SecOps (Samir Patel)
- Matt will deliver final data sample with tokenization notes by 2026-03-10 — Owner: Matt Jenkins (SonicData)
- Procurement will circulate SOW redline by 2026-03-11

We accept the proposed buffer (integration dry-run 2026-06-21, soft go-live 2026-07-22). Please send the cleaned MAP spreadsheet and a 60-minute kickoff invite for 2026-03-22.

Emily
Emily Reid
Senior Program Manager — Aurelia Systems
Quoted/forwarding notes included in messages above where applicable.
